{{Top|leg}}
The '''Maw Casino''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] aboard the ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]'', an [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial-II''-class Star Destroyer]] refitted by [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Booster Terrik]] as a [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]]. The Maw Casino was themed after its namesake, the cluster of [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]] known as [[Maw Cluster/Legends|The Maw]].
